CID routing: calls from particular callers, or numbers starting a certain way, go to a campaign, a queue, an agent (then a fallback), another call flow or an outside number, before the number's own flow. Call flows gain a "Go to another call flow" step.

Office phones (PBX): 3CX, Yeastar, FreePBX and any SIP PBX joined to the contact centre. Agents transfer to office extensions and see who is free; the office dials codes to reach call flows.

Sales module: products, pipeline and deals; quotes and orders on calls; sales campaigns; targets and commission; My sales on the agent desk.

Lead forms: Google Ads lead forms, website forms and Facebook Lead Ads, straight into lists and Sales.

Resellers: their own brand, addresses, carriers, numbers, email, opt-out lists, API keys, Xero and billing, with a reseller console and dashboard.

Platform: dashboards; servers that join as call or app servers; database pairs with takeover; alerts before disks run out.

Desk and supervision: the desk rings on an offered call; campaigns can auto-answer; predictive dialling speed; a call is kept when switching apps; quiet desks log out; supervisors can take calls.

Untapped AI: streamed voice beside SIP, transfers back to the platform, and the Untapped dashboard.

Sign-in: the new sign-in page."}
